name: habblaud
description: Habblaud plugins: the pixel-art virtual office of your Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: habblaud
plugins.description: Habblaud mod: plan usage (5-hour and weekly) for the office, a notice under the prompt when another session needs you, and the /habblaud command.

plugins.name: habblaud-permissoes
plugins.description: Approve or deny Claude Code's permission requests and answer the agent's questions from Habblaud (PermissionRequest hook).

plugins.name: habblaud-mensagens
plugins.description: Send messages from Habblaud: what you type in the office goes into the session as if you had typed it in the terminal.
